replay.rule: strata = class x group of the ORIGINAL training data (the train split the deployed model was trained on). A class with fewer than min_class_rows train rows in total keeps ALL its rows; otherwise each of its (class, group) strata keeps max(1, round(frac x n)) rows drawn uniformly without replacement (numpy default_rng(seed), one permutation per stratum in sorted stratum order). One buffer, written once with a manifest; every arm that replays uses that same buffer (a model's replay rows = the buffer rows that belong to its own training set).
